plugins.description: React/TypeScript + Go enforcement harness. Hooks enforce accessibility, React/TypeScript correctness, styling, env/data rules, warning-free tests and CI, security, PR feedback completeness, worktree safety, and lockfile parity. Skills cover planning, TDD, review, dependency upgrades, resilience, PR reviewability, visual planning, status summaries, CI-green shipping, and handoff. Includes Builder.io and Cursor Team Kit workflows. POSIX-friendly.

x-changelog.4.9.0: 2026-04-23 -- Green != done warnings gate (+2 hooks, 89->91 wired, 98->100 scripts). `test-warning-check.sh` (PostToolUse Bash) scans passing `vitest`/`bun test`/`playwright`/`tsgo`/`biome`/`lint` stdout+stderr for curated patterns: Node `DeprecationWarning`/`ExperimentalWarning`/`(node:) XxxWarning`, React `act()`/missing-key/DOM-nesting/prop-type/bad-setstate/non-boolean-attr, unhandled rejection + unhandled error, vitest `stderr |` during test, skipped counts, `@ts-expect-error` + `@ts-ignore`, `npm WARN deprecated`. No per-file or env warning bypass. 3x same-kind streak escalates. `ci-warning-audit.sh` (Stop) fetches `gh run view <id> --log` on green PR CI (per-SHA cache, 45s timeout), greps same pattern, blocks with file:line sample. Gates: feature branch, session touched code, PR exists, all checks SUCCESS. No CI warning env bypass. CLAUDE.md Tests + /tdd `When Done` updated. Why: green tests can spew deprecations / log errors / leak unhandled rejections -- tomorrow's bugs.
